Expense Claim

Footer templates allow you to add standardized text at the bottom of expense claims to communicate important information to employees.

You can create multiple footer templates tailored to different expense types, departments, or employee categories.

Name
Name

Footers appear at the bottom of expense claims and typically contain important policy information that employees need to understand when submitting expenses.

Common Uses for Footers

Footer templates are commonly used to display expense policy reminders, receipt requirements, approval workflows, reimbursement timelines, and compliance statements.

Different footer templates can be created for various expense categories such as travel expenses, entertainment expenses, or general office supplies.

Creating Footer Templates

When creating a footer template, give it a descriptive name that clearly identifies its purpose, such as 'Travel Expense Policy' or 'Local Expense Guidelines'.

Each expense claim can use a different footer template, allowing you to provide relevant information based on the type of expenses being claimed.
